meta_description:
16K likes, 128 comments - nikhilkamathcio on October 13, 2026: "UPI feels simple because most of what makes it work is invisible.

I followed one payment all the way through with Sameer Nigam (PhonePe), Harshil Mathur (Razorpay) and Sohini Rajola (NPCI): who moves the money, who pays the cost, and where fraud fits in. Then we argued about AI agents that could shop and pay for us.

What would you let an AI agent buy without asking you first?

Coming soon.".
